assets.visualReview: Inspected individually on paper and black backgrounds; no people, human hands, human faces or branding
assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, brands or labels. Include text, numbers or arrows only if the individual asset brief explicitly requires them. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: 1. `hms-survey-clipboard-v1.png`: a clipboard holding a printed survey sheet with rows of tick boxes and a few blank lined answer spaces (no readable words), a pen clipped on top. Plain.
assets.scope: HMS Module 1 or Module 2 v01-v08 only
